answer.rationale: Competitive price pressure on SMB base requires immediate, targeted response. memory_73 shows promotional pricing is effective for price-sensitive SMB segments with strong acquisition and revenue lift. memory_31 confirms signup simplification also works for SMB activation. The competitor's second price cut directly targets this segment; churn conversations have doubled. A standard experiment with promotional pricing on SMB cohorts is calibrated to defend qualified revenue without overcommitting to enterprise accounts (where exp_44 showed sales-assist is superior path). This preserves our ability to layer in activation messaging (memory_91, +6% activation) as secondary lever if needed. Referral incentives (memory_57) work on established customers, not retention defense. Broad rollout risks margin destruction; small test risks insufficient signal. Standard experiment allows rapid deployment while maintaining measurement discipline into next week when verification budget restores.
